= Include with indent= and Footnote Section

== indent=0 strips leading whitespace

[source,rust]
----
include::35_include_indent_part.adoc[indent=0]
----

== indent=2 re-indents to two spaces

[source,rust]
----
include::35_include_indent_part.adoc[indent=2]
----

== Footnotes

A short claim.footnote:[Source for the claim.]

A second claim.footnote:[A second source — with _emphasis_ inside.]
